source_claim_verbatim_translation: The group of path-homotopy classes of a topological space.
canonical_statement: For a topological space X with a chosen basepoint x, the based loops at x modulo endpoint-preserving path homotopy form a group: multiplication is induced by path concatenation, the identity by the constant loop, and inverse by path reversal.
domain_and_universes: X : Type u with TopologicalSpace X; x : X; the resulting FundamentalGroup X x is in a universe determined by X.
hypotheses: x is a chosen basepoint of X
conclusion: Endpoint-preserving homotopy classes of loops x to x carry the concatenation group structure.
scope_nodes: FG-ROOT based-loop homotopy classes form a group
FG-PATH paths and endpoint-preserving path homotopy
FG-QUOT quotient of paths by homotopy
FG-MUL concatenation descends to the quotient
FG-ONE the constant loop is the identity
FG-INV reversal descends and gives inverse
FG-LAWS associativity and two-sided identity/inverse laws

boundary_cases: No connectedness hypothesis is needed to define the group at a chosen basepoint.
An empty space has no selectable basepoint, so the binder x rules it out without a separate nonemptiness hypothesis.
Changing basepoint gives only a path-dependent isomorphism in general; unbased or free-loop homotopy classes are not the root.
The one-point space and spaces with only null-homotopic based loops yield a trivial group but remain in scope.
explicit_exclusions: the fundamental groupoid as a substitute for the vertex group
free homotopy classes of unbased loops
basepoint independence without path-connectedness and a chosen path
computations of the fundamental group of a particular space
the Seifert-van Kampen theorem and covering-space classification
